episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her proven strategies for generating and converting leads using YouTube, emphasizing the importance of structured systems like Zoom consults and exploratory trips. She also introduces the showing agent model as a solution for managing multiple clients effectively, offering tactical insights and practical advice for real estate agents looking to enhance their productivity and sales.
